name: default
description: Default Where I'd Eat ranking profile.
priorities: Excellent execution over prestige or price
Clear specialty, point of view, or standout dish
Food specific to the destination and harder to replace at home
Strong current local editorial support, then community signals such as Yelp
Short walks or rides unless a longer trip has a meaningful food payoff
Practical solo dining and low reservation friction when relevant
New openings only when current evidence supports the quality
penalties: Generic menus that could be anywhere
Places carried mainly by decor or hype
Weak value relative to nearby alternatives
Inconvenient trips without meaningful food payoff
